title: Apply for Recognition of Early Pregnancy Loss
summary: Learn how to apply for a Recognition of Early Pregnancy Loss certificate to memorialise a loss that occurred before 20 weeks.
intro:
You can commemorate an early pregnancy loss with a Recognition of Early Pregnancy Loss certificate.

This is not a legal document, but can be used to memorialise a loss that occurred before 20 weeks, or if weeks are unknown, a baby that weighed less than 400 grams.
who_can_apply: The loss must have occurred in NSW.
The loss must have occurred before 20 weeks, or if the weeks are unknown, the baby must have weighed less than 400 grams.

how_to_steps.text: Check you meet the eligibility requirements.
Download, print and complete the application form – Recognition of early pregnancy loss – PDF.
Send your completed application to the contact details listed on the form or lodge your application at a Service NSW Centre.

more_info.text: The Recognition of Early Pregnancy Loss application and certificate is free.
There is no time limit on when you can apply after your loss.
Processing times commence when applications are received in full compliance with Registry requirements, and exclude delivery time.

faqs.q: Is the Recognition of Early Pregnancy Loss certificate a legal document?
faqs.a: No, it is not a legal document, but it can be used to memorialise a loss.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for this certificate?
faqs.a: You must have experienced a loss in NSW that occurred before 20 weeks, or if the weeks are unknown, the baby weighed less than 400 grams.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the Recognition of Early Pregnancy Loss certificate?
faqs.a: Check eligibility, download and complete the application form, and then send it or lodge it at a Service NSW Centre.
